citation: Ayalew H, Tsang PW, Chu C, Wang J, Liu S, Chen C, Ma X. Comparison of TaqMan, KASP and rhAmp SNP genotyping platforms in hexaploid wheat
what_it_anchors: DESIGN SUCCESS IS NOT WORK SUCCESS: on one wheat panel, design was 49/50 (KASP) but 6.5% of 2,784 assay x sample points did not amplify and 13 calls were invalid; cluster-quality metrics exist per platform
claim: Design success 39/50 TaqMan, 49/50 KASP, 49/50 rhAmp of 50 pre-validated wheat SNVs; 30 of the 39 manufactured on all three platforms; one assay failed on all three, leaving 29 x 96 = 2,784 points; KASP 6.5% unamplified (printed as a percentage of points, not a count); invalid calls TaqMan 57, KASP 13, rhAmp 7, total 77; Table 3 KASP call quality 0.98, separation angle 0.19, compactness 0.20, NTC distance 1.51 (separation angle and compactness on the Allele-11 homozygous cluster only)
claim_kind: counts and platform means read from the full text; per-assay outcomes do not exist in this paper and are not asserted
access_detail: EPMC fullTextXML + PLOS S1 workbook (pone.0217222.s001.xlsx); both vendored into inst/extdata so data-raw/wheat_platform2019.R re-derives without a fetch

citation: Chen Z, Tang D, Ni J, Li P, Wang L, Zhou J, Li C, Lan H, Li L, Liu J. Development of genic KASP SNP markers from RNA-Seq data for map-based cloning and marker-assisted selection in maize
what_it_anchors: THE 92% IS A POLYMORPHISM RATE BETWEEN TWO INBREDS, NOT A DESIGN RATE: design was 50/50 and amplification was a separate 98.5% ratio
claim: 50 KASP markers were synthesised for 50 RNA-seq SNPs (design 50/50); 46 (92.00%) showed polymorphism between the inbreds 1212 and B73 by PCR (Additional file 4: 4 crosses, each with no PIC in the 20-line panel); the paper separately prints a 98.5% PCR amplification ratio with no count; in silico 71,311 KASP markers from 2,948,985 SNPs = 2.42%
claim_kind: per-marker tick/cross read from Additional file 4; the 92% recomputed as 46/50; the 98.5% and 2.42% recorded as printed
access_detail: EPMC fullTextXML + Springer 12870_2021_2932_MOESM4_ESM.xlsx; both vendored into inst/extdata

citation: Jagtap AB, Vikal Y, Johal GS. Genome-Wide Development and Validation of Cost-Effective KASP Marker Assays for Genetic Dissection of Heat Stress Tolerance in Maize
what_it_anchors: THE DESIGN/WORK DEFINITIONS, STATED BY A KASP PAPER: design 100/100, work 92/100 = 71 usable + 21 monomorphic-or-heterozygous, 8 no amplification signal
claim: Of 100 genome-wide RNA-seq SNVs, all 100 got a KASP assay (design success 100%); 71 (71%) were polymorphic on LM11 x CML25, 21 (21%) were monomorphic and/or heterozygous, 8 (8%) failed to amplify; the paper calls (71 + 21)/100 the work success rate, so 92% means "amplified", not "usable"
claim_kind: study-level counts read from Results 2.3 and Discussion; the three categories sum to 100 and the work rate recomputed as 92/100. Supporting data S2 prints primer triples for 92 of the 100 sites, which is recorded as a file observation, not as a design failure
access_detail: EPMC fullTextXML + MDPI supplementary zip (supportingdataS1/S2.xlsx); vendored into inst/extdata
